sources.used: Table I Re=2e6 subset; Table VII Re=2e6 sensitivity

transcription: Manual, checked against rendered original tables and independent OCR where legible.

reference.precision: 0.00005 is table rounding only; experimental error bars unavailable

assumptions.transition: free; fixed-transition sensitivity is a separate run
assumptions.pg: weak-compressibility lift estimate; not a measured Mach/Re airfoil map

assumptions.projection_gap: Original report does not fully specify the CL integration/projection algorithm; alternative chord-normal and relative-flow lift definitions are exported.
